name: Kouzuki Yuka
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c122376]Kouta's[/url] childhood friend. Even now, they are going to the same school and are in the same class.

She's gentle and kind to everyone, but is somewhat a pushover and cannot say no to favors. Moreover, she is quite shy and easily flustered when talking about love or sexual matters. 

She is very close to Kouta, and although they are of the same age, she loves him like an older brother. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/102/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
